GENETICS 
What about genetics? While it’s true that our genes can influence our susceptibility to weight gain, 
researchers say genes can’t be the sole cause of the increasing prevalence of obesity. Genes take 
many generations to evolve, and the rise in obesity has occurred over just the last 40 to 50 
years—only a few generations. When our grandparents were children, they were much less likely to 
become obese than our own children. That’s not because their genes were different, but more likely
